about_the_game:
Get ready to fly—literally.

Ragdoll LABS is a chaotic physics-based action game where you control a floppy ragdoll in wild, unpredictable simulations. Every match is a new chance to shine—or to be launched sky-high in the most humiliating way possible. Run, stumble, soar... and laugh. A lot.

Forget the rules. Especially gravity.
Pull off ridiculous stunts, break records (and bones), and unlock customization items to make your ragdoll as stylish as their wipeouts. Dive into nonsensical simulations and capture your finest (or most catastrophic) moments with the photo mode.

🎯 Absurd challenges in crazy levels
Dodge avalanches of giant balls, outrun rogue self-driving cars, fire cannons... Every level brings a brand-new, unpredictable, and absolutely hilarious challenge.

🤣 Physics has never been this fun (or painful)
Get crushed, run over, blown up, or zapped by lasers. Just laugh it off—grace was never part of the plan.

📸 Photo Mode and Slow Motion
Want to immortalize that epic jump-turned-disaster? Snap the perfect shot or slow it all down for maximum drama. Because every faceplant deserves a close-up.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.4GHz CPU Dual Core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / Radeon RX 560
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 2.8GHz CPU Dual Core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / Radeon RX 560
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Ragdoll LABS is a chaotic physics sandbox where nothing makes sense—and that’s exactly the point! Tackle absurd levels, survive epic accidents, and turn disaster into your favorite show. Customize your beloved ragdoll and master the art of failing in style!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian
